raw.product_description: narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. The "Observe" layer uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. The "Intelligence Layer" acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, the business value of tasks, and "drift" where work diverges from the intended flow. The "Execution Layer" is an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. It uses existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify areas for AI assistance.

core_insight.if_wrong: Companies will continue to struggle with AI adoption, unreliable ROI, and workflow drift, and narma will not provide a solution that scales effectively.
core_insight.source_excerpt: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a "Continuous AI lift."
core_insight.why_different: This system automates the entire lifecycle from observation to agent deployment, leveraging existing foundation models, rather than focusing on building new LLMs.

raw.thesis: narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to address the challenges of deploying AI automation at scale. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an "Observe" layer with desktop sensors to capture work patterns, an "Intelligence Layer" or "Brain" to detect employee intent, business value of tasks, and work divergence, and an "Execution Layer" or "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. This system leverages existing foundation models, focusing on understanding the "Work Graph" to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for AI intervention. The venture aims to provide a continuous AI optimization cycle, ensuring that AI-first companies can effectively identify, quantify, and implement AI automation, thereby eliminating resource wastage and ensuring consistent AI-driven improvements in workflows. narma's positioning is to complement existing AI infrastructure by providing the observability, intelligence, and execution framework necessary to operationalize and scale AI automation within large enterprises, addressing their pain points around telemetry, ROI measurement, and drift. The founder's implicit goal is likely a growth startup, given the focus on enterprise AI automation at scale. The venture appears to be at the idea stage, with a clear concept and architectural outline but no mention of development or user acquisition.
